value.rationale: The cuboctahedron L(Q3) is a natural Archimedean, four-regular and vertex-transitive graph; its line-graph origin and 48-element symmetry group motivate exact orbit/basin and geometric class invariants. The 146 fixed states, 20 completely isolated two-cycles, 14+3 symmetry classes and four-step sharp entry law are not routine deductions from the general period-two theorem or adjacent graph tables. These constitute a useful complete finite benchmark for deterministic edge-incidence majority dynamics, without requiring a downstream general theorem.
